retrievalProfile.description: A rustic portrait layout featuring a subject leaning on a foreground rail with heavy, distressed display typography anchored in the upper right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a male subject leaning on a dark metal railing, set against a weathered, light-colored industrial wall. The composition uses a strong diagonal from the railing and balances the subject on the left with heavy, textured typography on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left third balanced by text on the right third
Foreground railing creates a diagonal leading line across the lower half
Distressed text texture mirrors the weathered wall background
Warm skin tones and brown clothing contrast with cool teal typography
coreInvariants: Heavy distressed sans-serif display font for the primary name
Subject leaning on a horizontal or diagonal foreground element
Weathered, textured background with visible patina or rust

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, curved metal railing in the foreground provides a solid base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the arm down to the railing, then move right to the large display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant serves as a textured canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (browns and tans) in the subject's clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep teal used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for secondary text and foreground railing shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark foreground elements and the bright, weathered background wall.

letterConstructionRules: Eroded or 'stamped' texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature irregular, chipped edges to simulate weathered paint on metal.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed display font paired with a clean, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Thin diagonal 'scratch' lines intersecting the display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary text.
Good candidate for the clean, wide-tracked subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a brown sweater leaning on a dark, rusted metal pipe railing. The background is a weathered, off-white industrial wall with visible texture and patina. Leave the upper right quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, right-aligned, distressed teal sans-serif name in the upper right. Below it, add a smaller, clean black sans-serif title with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text heavily distressed?
Does the subject lean on a foreground element?
Is the color palette dominated by teal, brown, and tan?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the teal accent color
mustRedesign: Avoid using smooth, clean fonts for the main name
Do not center the subject in the frame

mustAchieve: Visible weathering on both background and text
Clear hierarchy between name and title

postGenerationChecks: Subject's gaze is directed slightly away from the camera
The teal color pops against the neutral background
The railing creates a clear sense of depth
